chapterInfo.content:
13
Onyankopɔn hyɛ Yosua sɛ ɔnkyekyɛ asase no mu
1Na Yosua abɔ akora na wadi mfeɛ pii; na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Woabɔ akora na woadi mfeɛ pii, na asase a aka sɛ wɔbɛfa no da so dɔɔso bebree. 2Asase a aka no nie: Filistifoɔ nsase nyinaa ne Gesur nyinaa. 3(Ɛde firi Sihor a ɛwɔ Misraim apueeɛ fam no ano de kɔsi Ekron hyeɛ so atifi fam no, wɔbu ma Kanaanfoɔ. Filistifoɔ ahemfo baanum no: Gasa deɛ ne Asdod deɛ, Askelon deɛ, Gat deɛ ne Ekron deɛ) ne Awifoɔ wɔ anafoɔ fam; 4Kanaanfoɔ asase no nyinaa ne Meara a ɛyɛ Sidonfoɔ dea no de kɔsi Afek kɔduru Amorifoɔ hyeɛ so; 5ne Gebalfoɔ asase ne Lebanon nyinaa wɔ owiapueeɛ de firi Baal-gad a ɛwɔ Hermon bepɔ aseɛ de kɔsi Hamat fam; 6#Yos 11.8 wɔn a wɔte bepɔ no soɔ nyinaa, de firi Lebanon ho de kɔsi Misrefot-maim, Sidonfoɔ nyinaa; me ara, mɛtu wɔn afiri Israelfoɔ no anim; ɛso ntonto nko na twe ma Israel na wɔmfa nni so, sɛdeɛ mehyɛɛ woɔ no. 7Na afei kyɛ asase yi mu na ɛnyɛ mmusuakuo nkron ne Manase abusuakuo fa no agyapadeɛ.
8 # Yos 13.15-32 Manase fa ne Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ anya wɔn agyapadeɛ a Mose de maa wɔn Yordan agya apueeɛ no, sɛdeɛ AWURADE akoa Mose de maa wɔn no, 9ɛfiri Aroer a ɛda Arnon subonhwa no ano no ho ne kuro a ɛda subonhwa no mu no, ne Medeba asaseta no nyinaa kɔsi Dibon, 10ne Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a ɔdii hene Hesbon no nkuro no de kɔsi Amonfoɔ hyeɛ so, 11ne Gilead ne Gesurfoɔ ne Maakatfoɔ asase ne Hermon bepɔ nyinaa ne Basan nyinaa de kɔsi Salka; 12Og a ɔdii hene wɔ Astarot ne Edrei ahennie a ɛwɔ Basan no nyinaa, (ɔno na ɔkaa abrane akɛseɛ no nkaeɛ no mu); na Mose kumm wɔn na ɔtuu wɔn, 13nanso Israelfoɔ antu Gesurfoɔ ne Maakatfoɔ, na Gesurfoɔ ne Maakatfoɔ no tenaa Israel mu de bɛsi nnɛ yi.
14 # Yos 13.33 Lewi abusuakuo no nko na wamma wɔn agyapadeɛ bie. AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn gya afɔdeɛ so adeɛ no, ɛno ne n’agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ no no.
Yordan apueeɛ fam asase yɛ mmusuakuo mmienu ne fa no dea
15 # Num 32 Na Mose de maa Ruben mma abusuakuo no sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. 16Na wɔn hyeɛ no firi Aroer a ɛda Arnon subonhwa no ano no ho ne kuro a ɛda subonhwa no mu ne Medeba ho asaseta no nyinaa. 17Hesbon ne ne nkuro a ɛdeda asaseta soɔ no nyinaa. Dibon ne Bamot-baal ne Bet-baal-meon 18ne Yahas ne Kedemot ne Mefaat 19ne Kiriataim ne Sibma ne Seret-sahar, bonhwa no mu bepɔ so 20ne Bet-peor ne Pisga bepɔ ase ne Bet-yesimot, 21asaseta no nkuro no nyinaa; ne Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a ɔdii hene Hesbon no ahennie nyinaa; ɔno na Mose kumm no ne Midian mmapɔmma, Ewi ne Rekem ne Sur ne Hur ne Reba, Sihon asafohene a wɔtenaa asase no soɔ no. 22#Num 22.5; 31.8 Na Beor ba Bileam, nkɔmhyɛfoɔ no nso, Israelfoɔ de nkrantɛ kumm no fraa atɔfoɔ no mu. 23Na Ruben mma no hyeɛ ne Yordan ne ɛho hyeɛ. Yei ne Ruben mma no agyapadeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ, nkuro no ne ɛho nkuraa.
24Na Mose de maa Gad abusuakuo, Gadfoɔ no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. 25Na wɔn hyeɛ ne Yaser ne Gilead nkuro no nyinaa, ne Amonfoɔ asase fa, de kɔsi Aroer a ɛda Raba anim no, 26na ɛfiri Hesbon de kɔsi Ramat-mispe ne Betonim, na ɛde firi Mahanaim de kɔsi Debir hyeɛ so; 27ne bonhwa no mu, Bet-haram ne Bet-nimra ne Sukot ne Safon a ɛyɛ Hesbon hene Sihon ahennie no nkaeɛ, Yordan ne ɛho hyeɛ, de kɔsi Kineret po no awieeɛ, Yordan agya apueeɛ. 28Yei ne Gadfoɔ agyapadeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ, nkuro no ne ɛho nkuraa.
29Na Mose maa Manase abusuakuo fa no nso bi, na ɛyɛɛ Manase abusuakuo fa no deɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. 30#Ate 10.3-4 Na wɔn hyeɛ firi Mahanaim, Basan nyinaa, Basan hene Og ahennie nyinaa ne Yair nkuro a ɛwɔ Basan no nyinaa, nkuro aduosia; 31ne Gilead fa ne Astarot ne Edrei, Og ahennie nkuro a ɛwɔ Basan no. Wɔde maa Manase ba Makir mma, sɛ ɛnyɛ Makir mma fa dea, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ.
32Yei ne agyapadeɛ a Mose kyekyɛɛ wɔ Moab mpaperɛ soɔ, Yeriko, Yordan agya apueeɛ. 33#Num 18.20-21 Na Lewi abusuakuo no deɛ, Mose amma wɔn agyapadeɛ biara: AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn, ɔno ne wɔn agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn no.

Na Yosua abɔ akora na wadi mfeɛ pii; na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Woabɔ akora na woadi mfeɛ pii, na asase a aka sɛ wɔbɛfa no da so dɔɔso bebree. Asase a aka no nie: Filistifoɔ nsase nyinaa ne Gesur nyinaa. (Ɛde firi Sihor a ɛwɔ Misraim apueeɛ fam no ano de kɔsi Ekron hyeɛ so atifi fam no, wɔbu ma Kanaanfoɔ. Filistifoɔ ahemfo baanum no: Gasa deɛ ne Asdod deɛ, Askelon deɛ, Gat deɛ ne Ekron deɛ) ne Awifoɔ wɔ anafoɔ fam; Kanaanfoɔ asase no nyinaa ne Meara a ɛyɛ Sidonfoɔ dea no de kɔsi Afek kɔduru Amorifoɔ hyeɛ so; ne Gebalfoɔ asase ne Lebanon nyinaa wɔ owiapueeɛ de firi Baal-gad a ɛwɔ Hermon bepɔ aseɛ de kɔsi Hamat fam; wɔn a wɔte bepɔ no soɔ nyinaa, de firi Lebanon ho de kɔsi Misrefot-maim, Sidonfoɔ nyinaa; me ara, mɛtu wɔn afiri Israelfoɔ no anim; ɛso ntonto nko na twe ma Israel na wɔmfa nni so, sɛdeɛ mehyɛɛ woɔ no. Na afei kyɛ asase yi mu na ɛnyɛ mmusuakuo nkron ne Manase abusuakuo fa no agyapadeɛ.
Manase fa ne Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ anya wɔn agyapadeɛ a Mose de maa wɔn Yordan agya apueeɛ no, sɛdeɛ AWURADE akoa Mose de maa wɔn no, ɛfiri Aroer a ɛda Arnon subonhwa no ano no ho ne kuro a ɛda subonhwa no mu no, ne Medeba asaseta no nyinaa kɔsi Dibon, ne Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a ɔdii hene Hesbon no nkuro no de kɔsi Amonfoɔ hyeɛ so, ne Gilead ne Gesurfoɔ ne Maakatfoɔ asase ne Hermon bepɔ nyinaa ne Basan nyinaa de kɔsi Salka; Og a ɔdii hene wɔ Astarot ne Edrei ahennie a ɛwɔ Basan no nyinaa, (ɔno na ɔkaa abrane akɛseɛ no nkaeɛ no mu); na Mose kumm wɔn na ɔtuu wɔn, nanso Israelfoɔ antu Gesurfoɔ ne Maakatfoɔ, na Gesurfoɔ ne Maakatfoɔ no tenaa Israel mu de bɛsi nnɛ yi.
Lewi abusuakuo no nko na wamma wɔn agyapadeɛ bie. AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn gya afɔdeɛ so adeɛ no, ɛno ne n’agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ no no.

Na Mose de maa Ruben mma abusuakuo no sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. Na wɔn hyeɛ no firi Aroer a ɛda Arnon subonhwa no ano no ho ne kuro a ɛda subonhwa no mu ne Medeba ho asaseta no nyinaa. Hesbon ne ne nkuro a ɛdeda asaseta soɔ no nyinaa. Dibon ne Bamot-baal ne Bet-baal-meon ne Yahas ne Kedemot ne Mefaat ne Kiriataim ne Sibma ne Seret-sahar, bonhwa no mu bepɔ so ne Bet-peor ne Pisga bepɔ ase ne Bet-yesimot, asaseta no nkuro no nyinaa; ne Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a ɔdii hene Hesbon no ahennie nyinaa; ɔno na Mose kumm no ne Midian mmapɔmma, Ewi ne Rekem ne Sur ne Hur ne Reba, Sihon asafohene a wɔtenaa asase no soɔ no. Na Beor ba Bileam, nkɔmhyɛfoɔ no nso, Israelfoɔ de nkrantɛ kumm no fraa atɔfoɔ no mu. Na Ruben mma no hyeɛ ne Yordan ne ɛho hyeɛ. Yei ne Ruben mma no agyapadeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ, nkuro no ne ɛho nkuraa.
Na Mose de maa Gad abusuakuo, Gadfoɔ no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. Na wɔn hyeɛ ne Yaser ne Gilead nkuro no nyinaa, ne Amonfoɔ asase fa, de kɔsi Aroer a ɛda Raba anim no, na ɛfiri Hesbon de kɔsi Ramat-mispe ne Betonim, na ɛde firi Mahanaim de kɔsi Debir hyeɛ so; ne bonhwa no mu, Bet-haram ne Bet-nimra ne Sukot ne Safon a ɛyɛ Hesbon hene Sihon ahennie no nkaeɛ, Yordan ne ɛho hyeɛ, de kɔsi Kineret po no awieeɛ, Yordan agya apueeɛ. Yei ne Gadfoɔ agyapadeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ, nkuro no ne ɛho nkuraa.
Na Mose maa Manase abusuakuo fa no nso bi, na ɛyɛɛ Manase abusuakuo fa no deɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. Na wɔn hyeɛ firi Mahanaim, Basan nyinaa, Basan hene Og ahennie nyinaa ne Yair nkuro a ɛwɔ Basan no nyinaa, nkuro aduosia; ne Gilead fa ne Astarot ne Edrei, Og ahennie nkuro a ɛwɔ Basan no. Wɔde maa Manase ba Makir mma, sɛ ɛnyɛ Makir mma fa dea, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ.
Yei ne agyapadeɛ a Mose kyekyɛɛ wɔ Moab mpaperɛ soɔ, Yeriko, Yordan agya apueeɛ. Na Lewi abusuakuo no deɛ, Mose amma wɔn agyapadeɛ biara: AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn, ɔno ne wɔn agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
